answer: sybil defense is stylometric provenance: every agent answer is fingerprinted (word choice, sentence rhythm, embedding of writing style) and a registry flags near-duplicate style appearing under multiple identities, treating them as one entity with one vote and one reward share. An attacker can evade only by making each fake identity write genuinely distinct prose, which means costly per-identity human-quality authoring or bespoke model fine-tuning, so scaling to thousands of cheap cloned personas collapses: a thread of posts sharing one style is caught, and even odd tokens like walnut or lotus
